requirements:
# Multi-Pump Switching Control System - **Difficulty:** Medium (medium) ## Requirements In an industrial water supply system, there are 5 pumps, each of which can be controlled independently. The system needs to support both manual and automatic operating modes. Based on the value of the mode variable, switch to the corresponding operating mode. In manual mode, control the start and stop of the selected pump based on the value of pumpGroup[1..5].selection. In automatic mode, compare the priority of each pump, and automatically select the 3 pumps with higher priority for water supply according to the method of three in use and two on standby. ## Interface Definition | Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Input | `mode` | `BOOL` | FALSE: Manual mode
TRUE: Automatic mode | | Input | `start` | `BOOL` | Start button, used to start the manually selected or automatically selected pump | | Input | `stop` | `BOOL` | Stop button, used to stop all pumps | | Input/Output | `pumpGroup` | `ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump` | Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd. | **Data type `ST_Pump`** | Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `priority` | `INT` | Priority; larger values have higher priority. Read-only to the function block. | | `selection` | `BOOL` | Manual-selection state. Read-only to the function block. | | `RunComd` | `BOOL` | Run command written by the function block; TRUE runs and FALSE stops. |
scenario: In an industrial water supply system, there are 5 pumps, each of which can be controlled independently. The system needs to support both manual and automatic operating modes.

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: Stop wins over a simultaneous start.
Read-only priority and selection fields must be unchanged.
assumptions: stop has priority over start and clears all five commands.
A start command selects the running set from current mode/configuration; commands are retained while neither button is TRUE. There is no automatic selection change until another start.
Equal priorities are resolved by lower array index first. Selection is ignored in automatic mode.
The caller initializes every RunComd FALSE before creating the first operational scan. Only RunComd may be written.
The specification_contract is normative and supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

V2 confirms the existing evaluation policy: start is level-sensitive and reselects each TRUE invocation; without start, mode/selection/priority changes do not reselect. Automatic top-three applies to selection events, not unconditionally to every automatic invocation.

ltl.explanation: Manual start uses exactly the selected pumps.

ltl.formula: G((!stop & start & mode) -> (forall i in 1..5: runs[i]=(i in top3)))
ltl.explanation: Automatic start runs exactly the highest-priority three.
The FB may not modify priorities or selections.
The complete per-invocation relation defined in specification_contract.normative_completion; requires explicit encoding before model checking.

atomic_propositions.top3: The three indices with highest priority, lower index winning a tie.
atomic_propositions.runPrev[i]: The pre-scan RunComd value of pump i.
atomic_propositions.readOnlyPreserved: All five priority and selection values equal their sampled values.
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or output.
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehaviorV2: 明确运行态、启动/停止及重选事件的契约，给出每拍对全部五个RunComd的方程。以排序键(-priority,index)独立算top3，所有priority/selection保持采样值，不允许排序时交换整个结构破坏外部顺序。

tests.purpose: Manual latching, read-only fields and simultaneous stop/start
Automatic top-three selection and deterministic ties

specification_contract.observation: I[k] is sampled before execution; O[k] is observed after execution. Initial conditions apply before invocation zero.
specification_contract.normative_completion: 明确运行态、启动/停止及重选事件的契约，给出每拍对全部五个RunComd的方程。以排序键(-priority,index)独立算top3，所有priority/selection保持采样值，不允许排序时交换整个结构破坏外部顺序。
specification_contract.history_binding: Every previous-output name refers to the preceding observed output with the declared initial value. Previous-input memories update on EVERY invocation, including reset, invalid input, stop and mode change. Reference phase/history is independently advanced from sampled inputs by the stated transition rules, never supplied by the candidate.
specification_contract.evaluation_scope: Properties include interpreted data predicates. No claim of export to a model checker or completed formal proof.
